'''Irstats''' were [[Tarasin]] tribal groups that dwelled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Irstats usually consisted of between about thirty or fifty members, although some irstats were larger and the [[Hiironi irstat]]&mdash;the most populous irstat&mdash;had over three hundred members. Each irstat was led by an [[Irstat-Kes]], who was usually the second oldest [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the tribe. The eldest female in the irstat held the title "[[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]]" and acted as a figurehead for the tribe, by embodying the best aspects of Tarasin culture. Mothers and Irstat-Kes' were often [[Force Adept]]s, although this was not mandatory.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
